request.scope: Regenerate the builtin default character with the five-fold (moba-coach-manager) champion portrait face as identity reference, keeping the approved lounge outfit and thigh-up framing; local working-tree replacement and native verification only. No commit, push or release requested.

prompts.identityCorrect: <image1> is a close crop of the current approved Rubelia illustration, not a new character design. <image2> is a crop from the five-fold champion portrait of the SAME Rubelia and is the sole facial identity reference. Redraw ONLY the visible face inside {faceEditRect} of <image1> so it is clearly the specific woman in <image2>, not merely another red-haired green-eyed anime woman: her larger bright clear green eyes with a defined dark upper lash line, visible pupils and fine highlights, natural open eyelids (no sleepy hooded look), softly rounded cheeks with light blush, small nose with a tiny highlight, and a gentle closed-lip smile with soft pink lips. Preserve the exact head tilt, facial location and size, feature positions, eyebrows placement, every hair strand and the side-swept bangs, hair ornament, earrings, ears, neck and framing of <image1>. The nose and eyes must stay registered to the existing head. Keep the crisp fine anime ink lines, polished cel shading and lighting of <image1>. No pasted face or cutout, no generic doll face, no dark background, no black-red dress, no gold chains or other outfit elements from <image2>, no new accessories, no change outside the face.
prompts.pose: Generate ONE genuinely new complete high-resolution anime illustration of the SAME mature adult Rubelia, in a DIFFERENT intentional whole-body pose. <image1> is the user-approved exact visual authority for her own face, striking red hair, clearly green eyes, small gold hair ornament, white camisole and white shorts, confident crisp fine anime ink lines, polished cel shading, gentle highlights and proportions. <image2> is an unaltered crop of THIS SAME approved image and supplies ONLY precise face/eye/ornament identity, not a face to paste or a second person. Keep her unusually large head including entire hair and ornament through upper thighs filling nearly the entire 1280-square portrait height; leave enough margin around both arms, both complete intact hands and head. Render fresh coherent anatomy, naturally connected neck/shoulders/arms/hands, own newly drawn expression and pose; do NOT swap a donor face, trace, transform, resize, or composite the original image. Pose intent: {intent}. Single adult woman on plain opaque white background. No chibi, no child, no blue eyes, no blonde hair, no fantasy outfit, no school uniform, no text, no panels, no props. Preserve original identity, outfit and visual style while making a genuinely distinct whole illustration.

eyeContours.method: Neutral eye apertures and irides come only from reviewed See-through alpha masks (sourceEyeMasks/sourceIrisMasks) checked against actual source pigment; the upstream warm-RGB fallback is refused.

registration.method: Similarity (scale + translation) coarse-to-fine search on panel 1 (open eyes) over the own nose/eye/eyebrow patch with front hair and the neutral mouth excluded. Panel 0 (closed eyes; eye apertures and lash contours also excluded) reuses panel 1 scale (same Qwen render) and searches translation only near panel 1 translation; panel 0 scale is verified by a free similarity match of panel 0 to panel 1 on the shared sheet content outside eyes and mouth.

closedLids.method: Hue-independent luma contrast below local skin inside the eye anchor box; own front hair and eyebrow alpha excluded; upstream ridge tracing and edge unmixing retained.

mouthExpressions.method: Upstream mouth window/width constants multiplied by k derived from the reviewed neutral mouth width (k = 1 inside the upstream-tuned neutral range); window top kept below the own nose, bottom above the own face bottom minus a margin, sides inside the own face; features touching both window sides or wider than the ratio limit are rejected.
